_comment: Synthetic mock-account configuration for R-bench item n8n:12679. All ids are our own; the author's account ids are never committed (the original-definition control rebinds them by role, see controls/original.mjs).

doi.label: double opt-in list (Pending until the subscriber confirms)

created.label: set on subscribers created from a Zoho create/update

createdViaForm.label: set on subscribers created from a Zoho web-form submission

activationSend.label: activation tag: KlickTipp fires the 'contact tagged' webhook when it is applied

activationDeleted.label: activation tag: KlickTipp fires the 'contact deleted' webhook when it is applied
